'''Endor Gentleman's Club''' is a modern Star Wars CCG playtest team. Olson added it to the spreadsheet on 8 November 2023.<ref name="forum-81218">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (arebelspy), Players Committee Forums (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). Live sheet: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing Google Sheets]. Wayback: https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing. Wiki copy: [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]].</ref>
